notes.title: Leaving Early Access - Version 1.0
notes.notes:
We've been in Early Access for a little more than a year and now Miasma Caves is leaving early access! Thanks for everyone who followed along with us.

We're not done working on Miasma Caves. Our focus going forward will be to add more variety to the game, more Lost Lands, townsfolk, quests, animals, and achievements in the coming months.

Thank you all again. We hope you'll keep with us as we improve Miasma Caves and beyond. 



Change Log: [list]
[*] Ice caverns have been now found in the caves
[*] The buildings will now look better when they are upgraded
[*] A new lost land has appeared in the caves. There are rumors are of a frozen lake
[*] Added an UI effect to flash when taking damage that isn't from time
[*] Added credits to the main menu
[*] The abyss holes in the cave will no long appear
[*] Added in a fix that if Lesath gets buried under the ground she will get on top of it
[*] Dirt and rocks that have fallen will be easier to dig
[*] Dead ends will be less likely to generate
[*] When you use a torch in the tutorial will last until the complete the tutorial
[*] Slightly reduced the number of side paths in the caves
[*] Fixed bug where falling damage occurred when it shouldn't have
[*] Fixed bug where you could unequip a pickaxe but still use it
[*] Fixed a bug where some sound effects were playing at the wrong time
[*] Air Cleansers no longer have a time limit
[*] Fixed a lighting bug with Lost Lands
[*] Fixed bug where it would show the well being upgraded without it being purchased
[*] Fixed bug where waymarkers would sometimes disappear when you got too far away from them
[*] The digging decals should now properly go away when the ground they are on is destroyed
[*] The missing animal portraits for the Wisp and Pangomole are there
[*] The Lost lands have their own portraits for the catalog
[*] Fixed bug that allowed the duplication of treasures
[*] Fixed bug that would prevent jumping from some ledges
[*] Animals should no longer spawn floating
[*] Cumulo are now 20% more bouncy
[*] Slimes will be a little more stuborn when eating gems
[*] Fixed bug in catalog where portraits would not always be visable

[/list]

notes.title: Major Update 0.9.0
notes.notes:
We've got a huge patch here and we are nearing coming out of early access. Firstly, the 4th Depth will now generate at the bottom of the cave! This section contains lots of danger and lots of riches. Beware, lava makes falling a much more fatal mistake. 

With this update any caves generated in a previous update will be removed and replaced with a new cave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32380662/bbde5200e5e63c3f72b7405d7ce4e09c005be3e3.png[/img]

While not visible we have been working on our cave loading and generation a lot the past few months and we've moved to using LOD, so the cave will no longer need a large load time when you start the game or make a new cave. It will load as you explore, and just the area around you.

We're also introducing more animals! 
We have the Duskling, a mischievous critter that flies around the cave, picking up treasures to fly away with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32380662/7905b322f1f846fb4cd9c7067fd8bec7657af0b3.png[/img]

The Pangomole, a slow critter that wanders around and digs. When scared it will take off quickly and destroy a wall, watch out for cave ins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32380662/a340b68a25887cc4067e4f665417ece4a0cf8db2.png[/img]

The Will o'Wisp, the last of the new critters that look like waymarkers from afar. They lead travelers astray down wrong paths, but if caught will provide a powerful light orb or rarely some equipment that generates light!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32380662/6e3a13a798b100b628fdbf0643cc0f63d70d85df.png[/img]

Change Log:
[list]
[*] LOD! The cave is changed to now load as you explore instead of generating the whole cave at the start. Cave generation should be much faster!
[*] 4th Depth! Venture further into the cave to the most dangerous areas. Amazing treasure awaits, but so do bigger dangers.
[*] New Animal!: Duskling, a mischievous creature they will carry treasures away. 
[*] New Animal!: The Pangomole, a slow creature that digs large holes.
[*] New Animal!: Will o'wisp, an orb of light that leads adventurers astray
[*] The catalog will now have entries for when you find Animals and Lost Lands

notes.title: Basalt Caves Update (v0.8)
notes.notes:
Big patch here! We're finishing up the first phase in our roadmap to get in the next depth of cave into the game, the Basalt Caves! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32380662/09695c153b4af05f311e3cd0bed1a62929dc0b68.png[/img]

The Basalt caves are more dangerous than the previous sections, while not as vertical as the the limestone caves, they are is some overlap with some of the chasms appearing in both. The ground in this section is less stable than above, and it takes a lot of adventuring to reach it, making more the the shops tools more important. In the Basalt caves some new things will be forming, ruins of the ancient civilization will be findable, along with new types of treasures. 

These areas will be available next time you start a new cave. If your continuing from a saved game, talk to Turies in town to reset the cave and see all the new wonders!

Going forward our next big tasks are going to be spending extra time tracking down bugs and cleaning up the game before getting to the next grouping of new content.

Full 0.8 patch notes;
[list]
[*] Dialog will now always wait for input before closing
[*] Updated treasure glow
[*] Waymarkers are now fully visable through the darkness
[*] Waymarkers should no longer occasionally fall through the floor
[*] Shimmering Waymarkers are now cheaper

[*] The Mine Camp Lost Land now only generates at the end of Mines
[*] The mouse wheel will work correctly in the shop
[*] Lesath should no longer be able to fall into the abyss
[*] New Town upgrades

[/list]

notes.title: Saving Update (0.7.1.11)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We're closing in on getting through Phase 1 of the roadmap with the 3rd depth coming soon. But before that we are wanted to get in one more big feature, Cave Saving! Now if you quit anywhere in the cave, when you come back you will return right where you left off, lost hopelessly in the cave. 

One other bonus today, we have added a prize at the bottom of the cave, see if you can find it.
